body:
## What's Changed
* apps wall: add Otuli: Shared Baby Tracker by @markbattistella in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2725
* apps wall: add Reed: Breathwork & Pranayama by @ebordasc in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2727
* Reject a mismatched Bundle ID before enabling a capability by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2653
* Refuse App Group identifiers on unassign and set by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2637
* Require confirmation before completing a phased release by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2641
* Require confirmation before changing monthly-commitment billing by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2651
* Run workflow error hooks after cancellation by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2648
* Page analytics instances for insights weekly by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2645
* Bound streaming downloads by the caller context by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2652
* fix(insights): paginate analytics metadata by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2729
* Give each dSYM download its own request timeout by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2642
* Normalize IAP price schedule base territory by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2647
* Treat an already-present tester as a skip on add-groups by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2644
* Hydrate Xcode Cloud product bundle IDs in one list request by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2649
* Stop retrying ambiguous one-time API key downloads by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2650
* Pin profile and certificate lists against a platform filter by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2657
* fix(migrate): remove stale files during metadata export by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2731
* feat(signing): create a missing certificate during signing fetch by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2694
* feat(pricing): default schedule create --start-date to today in UTC by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2606
* feat(screenshots): list every localization when --locale is omitted by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2605
* Expire earlier builds of one app version by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2688
* Create Apple Pay merchant certificates through the API by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2687
* fix(game-center): stop repeated leaderboard-set pagination by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2733
* feat(cli): accept root --profile after the command name by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2607
* feat(cli): suggest the intended flag on unknown flags for every command by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2620
* Validate custom product page previews before sync delete by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2640
* feat(xcode): convert an existing xcresult to JUnit and list destinations by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2678
* apps wall: add GCC Talent by @FnrDev in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2732
* feat(cli): name stray positional operands and the flag they probably meant by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2618
* perf(screenshots,analytics): bound screenshot and report fan-out by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2684
* fix(xcode): reject Mac destinations off macOS by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2735
* fix(cli): omit non-exact stray hints by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2737
* Merge paginated included resources in linear time by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2643
* feat(cli): --if-exists skip|update|fail for versions create and review details-create by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2579
* Stabilize sequential screenshot failure fixture by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2738
* feat(bundle-ids): reconcile capabilities from an entitlements file by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2700
* Roll back failed background-asset submits on a fresh context by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2646
* feat(cli): --if-exists skip|update|fail for localizations create by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2583
* Import in-app purchases from a local JSON file by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2692
* apps wall: add TeethPath by @Yipxiyi in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2741
* apps wall: add RTSP & RTMP Cam - OctoStream by @khakra in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2740
* fix(web): fail closed on ambiguous App Group removals by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2742

## New Contributors
* @markbattistella made their first contribution in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2725
* @ebordasc made their first contribution in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2727
* @FnrDev made their first contribution in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2732
* @Yipxiyi made their first contribution in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2741
* @khakra made their first contribution in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2740

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/compare/5.4.0...5.5.0
